page.layout: One printed page: a title block centred in the upper half, four lines in large capitals. Below it blank paper. Digitiser's watermark "Google" at lower right is not transcribed.
page.notes: Title page of Justus Lipsius, "Ad libros de Cruce notæ". The first line is set with spaced capitals; the Æ in the last line is a ligature. The rest of the page is blank apart from stains, show-through and the digitiser's mark.
